question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**improved**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes how students found science simpler through the use of comic strips, leading to a positive outcome.
 
• The appropriate verb should reflect a positive change in students' academic performance.
 
• **"Improved"** fits well as it suggests that the students' performance got better as a result of the new teaching method.
 
• Other options ('**reframed**', '**regained**', '**regretted**') do not accurately depict an enhancement in performance.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Santosh Bisen, science teacher and cartoonist at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Durg, Chhattisgarh used__ his drawing **__skills__ to convert chapters into comic strips. "Convincing authorities to turn textbooks into comics was difficult. I spent my own money to **__design__ textbooks. I also used cartoons in question papers," he says. "Students were **__thrilled__ with how simple science became and their performance **__improved__**," he adds.** *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reframed **(पुनर्गठित करना): "Reframed" suggests restructuring or expressing something differently, which does not imply a change in academic performance.
 
• **Regained **(पुनः प्राप्त करना): "Regained" means to obtain something again, which does not accurately convey enhancement in performance.
 
• **Regretted **(पछताना): "Regretted" means to feel sorrow or remorse, which does not fit the positive context of improved performance.
